meta.title: Cristian Cardona — Professional Evolution
meta.description: Cristian Cardona's evidence-backed professional evolution from Full Stack and Cloud toward AI Engineering, AI Automation, and Agentic Systems.

ui.hero_title: Building from a Full Stack + Cloud foundation toward AI Engineering.
ui.hero_lede: A deliberately honest portfolio of demonstrated work, developing capabilities, and the direction still being built.
ui.principle_text: Evidence before confidence. Direction is labelled as direction; prototypes are not presented as production systems.
ui.review_banner: Draft public snapshot. Content is intentionally conservative and requires human review before external use.
ui.evidence_intro: Every statement has a status. The absence of public proof is shown as a gap instead of being filled with marketing language.
ui.projects_intro: A prototype can be useful without being production-ready. Planned work remains planned until there is something public to inspect.
ui.trajectory_text: The intended move is not a reset. It is a deliberate extension of existing full stack and cloud practice into AI engineering, automation, and agentic systems.
ui.trajectory_note: This is a direction of travel, not a claim that the destination has already been reached.
ui.goals_intro: These are draft public goals, not deadlines or promises. They are here to make the direction inspectable.
ui.boundary_heading: What this portfolio will not pretend to know.
ui.no_rag: No production RAG claim is made.
ui.no_private_details: No location, employer, client, compensation, or language-proficiency details are asserted.
ui.no_metrics: No arbitrary progress percentages or years-of-experience figures are used.
ui.historical_context: Historical LinkedIn-sync material is context, not the source of truth.
ui.evidence_heading_public: Open the evidence behind the claims.
ui.evidence_intro_public: Evidence links show what can be inspected publicly. They do not automatically prove historical employer work or production operation.
ui.no_filter_results: No claims match this evidence filter.
ui.snapshot_error: The approved public snapshot could not be loaded. No fallback claims are rendered.
ui.ai_note: Transition in progress · public proof being built

claim-fullstack-cloud-foundation.text: Full stack web development with a cloud engineering component is the existing base of this portfolio.
claim-fullstack-cloud-foundation.notes: Public evidence is a self-reported profile page. It points to publicly described work but does not independently verify depth or scale.

claim-cloud-engineering-practice.text: Hands-on cloud engineering practice is part of the existing base, focused on containerised and managed-runtime environments.
claim-cloud-engineering-practice.notes: Scoped to what the public profile describes. No architecture, cost or reliability outcome is asserted here.

claim-ai-engineering-transition.text: Transition toward AI Engineering is in progress rather than complete.
claim-ai-engineering-transition.notes: Recorded as direction of travel. No public artifact demonstrates applied AI engineering delivery yet.

claim-ai-automation.text: AI Automation is an intended area of focus going forward.
claim-ai-automation.notes: Intent only. Not demonstrated and not verifiable from any public source.

claim-agentic-systems.text: Agentic Systems is an intended area of focus going forward.
claim-agentic-systems.notes: Intent only. No agent, tool-use or orchestration artifact is public.

claim-ai-chat-prototype-exists.text: The AI Engineering Reliability Lab is a public prototype with deterministic representative answers, bounded citations, insufficient-evidence responses, and request-limit tests.
claim-ai-chat-prototype-exists.notes: Public reproduction of an AI API reliability boundary. It does not use a model provider, implement RAG, or claim production operation.

claim-no-production-rag.text: A production retrieval-augmented-generation (RAG) capability is NOT demonstrated. The prototype does not implement a retrieval pipeline, an evaluation harness, or production operation.
claim-no-production-rag.notes: Deliberate negative claim. Any public copy that implies production RAG is contradicted by this entry.

claim-cloud-dashboard-planned.text: Cloud Dashboard is planned work. It is not built, not deployed, and has no public artifact.
claim-cloud-dashboard-planned.notes: Planned/not-yet-public. Must not be presented as a demonstrated project.

claim-saas-mvp-planned.text: SaaS MVP is planned work. It is not built, not deployed, and has no public artifact.
claim-saas-mvp-planned.notes: Planned/not-yet-public. Must not be presented as a demonstrated product.

claim-years-of-experience-unverified.text: No years-of-experience figure is asserted. Any such number appearing in historical marketing copy is unverified and must not be reused.
claim-years-of-experience-unverified.notes: Deliberate negative claim. Guards against copying inflated figures out of unreviewed drafts.

claim-public-code-artifact-missing.text: There is no verified public code repository URL for any project in this snapshot.
claim-public-code-artifact-missing.notes: Placeholder handles in unreviewed drafts are not evidence and are deliberately not carried over.

short.statement: Turn the AI chat prototype into a small set of publicly inspectable AI engineering artifacts that a reviewer can open and judge without trusting a description.
short.question: Which artifacts are worth publishing, and under which public identity?

medium.statement: Build and publish the planned projects so that the AI engineering and automation direction is backed by demonstrable work rather than by stated intent.
medium.question: Which planned project carries the most signal for the intended direction?

long.statement: Establish a defensible position in agentic systems, grounded in published artifacts and in work that was actually delivered rather than planned.
long.question: What does defensible mean concretely for this portfolio?
